title: dendranthema integrifolium
intro: Dendranthema integrifolium, commonly known as Chinese astilbe or astilbe chinensis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in digestion. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Dendranthema integrifolium include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
